proof_summary: Positivity supplies, for every center \(n>6\), a prime \(p\) and a symmetric prime pair \(n-k,n+k\), with \(k=p n'-1\). For Goldbach one takes \(n=m/2\), so the pair sums to \(m\); for Lemoine one takes the even center \(n=N-1\), giving \(k=2p-1\) and \(N=(n-(2p-1))+2p\), while the finitely many small boundary cases are handled directly.
